title: ClearPath Late-Fee Rate by Payment Record
content:
**Rate clause.** The late-fee rate of the late fee on a ClearPath Managed IT Services invoice reads the late fees and the payments posted on the agreement in the last 12 months (a month window ending today):

(a) with no late fee in that window and 10 or more payments, the rate is 1.0 percent;

(b) with no late fee in that window and fewer payments, 1.25 percent;

(c) with a late fee in that window, the tier's late fee per month percent.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. Late fees and payments are counted from the agreement's billing ledger by posting date, each entry once.

| Late fees in the last 12 months | Payments in the last 12 months | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| none | 10 or more | 1.0 percent |
| none | 9 or fewer | 1.25 percent |
| one or more | any | the tier's late fee per month (1.5 percent on every tier) |

**Hypothetical case.** On an unpaid balance of 2000.00 the rate under (a) gives 20.00, under (b) 25.00 and under (c) 30.00, before any other change to the fee.
